notes:
Closer Room sync
Private realtime refresh notices reduce the wait for accepted playback commands. Paused seeks apply without pressing Play; YouTube may load a nearby keyframe. No zero-delay or frame-perfect guarantee.

A shared little cinema
Search and Room-chat typing indicators, shared submitted search query/results, message replies, and compact Room-online names. Typing and reactions are transient with no offline replay; Room replies delete with the Room.

Fullscreen reactions
APK2.16 can show received emoji on the right side of YouTube native landscape fullscreen as well as Room theatre. Real two-device playback, ads, buffering, OEM fullscreen and rotation require device testing. Existing locks, solo playback and screenshot protection remain. Install over the app without uninstalling or clearing data.
